_comment: Cross-language constants. Read by build/_console.{py,js} and build/_env_contract.{py,js} at module init. Do not edit values here without considering the visual + functional impact across both runtimes; the snapshot test will catch user-visible regressions, but env-var name changes silently break the contract between processes. See _console.py and _env_contract.py for usage docs.

console._comment_ansi: ANSI dim/reset sequences. \u001b is ESC (0x1B). JSON does not support \x; the \u form is portable to both Python and Node JSON parsers.
console._comment_symbols: Status emoji. ⚠ and ℹ carry the U+FE0F variation selector to force emoji (not text/monochrome) presentation on terminals that default them otherwise.
console._comment_banner: Banner geometry: total width 70, including spaces around the label. '─── ' (4 columns) + label + ' ' (1) + tail = 70.
console._comment_indent: Bullet lines render as (BULLET_INDENT) + (emoji, 2 cols) + ' ' + message. Detail text aligned under the message starts at column BULLET_INDENT + 3, which is 5 spaces.
console._comment_pad: Label-value pairing for ok_pair / err_pair / etc. The value column starts after a colon + padding so a sequence of pair lines aligns vertically. 23 covers every label currently used.

env_contract._comment: Env-var NAMES (the strings used as os.environ.get() / process.env[...] keys), not their values. Values are documented at each consumer's read site since they carry domain-specific meaning.
env_contract._comment_data_source: Selects which YAML data file the build consumes. 'default' → require data/resume_default.yml (error if missing). 'local' → require data/resume.local.yml (error if missing). unset → use local if present, else default (developer-friendly).
env_contract._comment_skip_snapshot: When '1', render.js skips the visual-regression snapshot step. Set by snapshot_pdf.py --update-all so the two intermediate builds (whose PDFs ARE the new fixtures) don't compare against the fixtures they're about to replace.
env_contract._comment_suffix: Free-form label appended to render.js's first phase banner so the user sees 'Tests (default data)' / 'Tests (local data)' at the top of each pass during a multi-source rebuild. Set by snapshot_pdf.py --update-all; unset in normal builds.
